project_type: TypeScript monorepo — multi-framework UI component library (@ui-construction-library/*)
build_system: pnpm v11.7 + Turbo + Rollup per package. Token build: 'node packages/tokens/scripts/build-w3c.mjs' (from workspace root). Per-package build: 'pnpm --filter <pkg> build'. Full build: 'pnpm build'.
test_framework: Vitest v4. Per-package: 'pnpm --filter <pkg> test'. Run from workspace root.
build_command: node packages/tokens/scripts/build-w3c.mjs  (tokens only, fast). pnpm --filter @ui-construction-library/tokens build:w3c  (same via script). pnpm build  (full monorepo, slow).
test_command: pnpm --filter @ui-construction-library/tokens test && pnpm --filter @ui-construction-library/behaviors test && pnpm --filter @ui-construction-library/core test
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'node packages/tokens/scripts/build-w3c.mjs' from workspace root to regenerate all token artifacts. 2. Confirm new --ucl-* vars appear in packages/tokens/dist/w3c/tokens.css. 3. Run the three test commands above; all must exit 0. 4. Run 'pnpm --filter @ui-construction-library/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @ui-construction-library/behaviors typecheck' for TS safety.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/tokens/src/tokens.runtime.generated.ts (generated by build-w3c.mjs — MUST be committed). packages/tokens/dist/w3c/tokens.css, tokens.ts, tokens.resolved.json, tokens.w3c.json (generated — commit dist/w3c/). These are checked in.
environment_constraints: Working tree is clean on main at commit 7dcfde9. Breaking changes are OK. Do NOT push — local commits only.
contribution_requirements: Biome v2.4.15 linter (lineWidth 80, single quotes). Run 'pnpm --filter <pkg> lint' before committing. Changesets not required for plan steps. Generated files (tokens.runtime.generated.ts) have a 'do not edit' header — update only by running the build script.
key_patterns: 1. deriveName() in build-w3c.mjs: color.component.light.<comp>.<path...> → parts.slice(3).join('-') → --ucl-<comp>-<path...>. 2. All new CSS rules in components.css use var(--ucl-<token>, <semantic-fallback>) pattern to degrade gracefully without ThemeProvider. 3. Button behavior uses cx() not CVA; className built as 'ucl-button ucl-button--{variant}' + optional size modifier class. 4. ThemeProvider injects LIGHT_CSS/DARK_CSS (--ucl-* vars) via data-theme attribute; globals.css provides legacy --primary/--error/etc aliases as fallback.
directory_structure: packages/tokens/src/ — W3C JSON source + legacy cssVariables.ts; packages/tokens/scripts/ — build-w3c.mjs generator; packages/tokens/dist/w3c/ — generated artifacts (committed); packages/core/src/styles/ — components.css (component CSS) + globals.css (legacy var aliases); packages/core/src/types/ — shared TS types; packages/behaviors/src/ — framework-agnostic ARIA/class factories
